name: kb_matrix_scalar_multiply
description: Matrix-scalar multiplication: C = A * s. This is a trivial memory-bound operation where each element is independently scaled. Primary optimization target is memory bandwidth utilization.

M.description: Number of rows in the matrix

N.description: Number of columns in the matrix

name: kb_matrix_scalar_fma
description: Matrix-scalar fused multiply-add: C = A * s + b. Variant of scalar multiplication that includes an addition, testing fusion capabilities.

M.description: Number of rows in the matrix

N.description: Number of columns in the matrix
